description: Diagnostic, not a method. Frozen B41 + valid-terminal STOP. Hard keep/edit mask from MCS-aligned source-target labels. Planner does not predict WRITE/DELETE/SET or birth. Random control matches per-graph atom and source-source bond edit counts. π is not a target molecule.
hypothesis: B41's bottleneck is not knowing where not to edit, rather than inability to execute edits. Oracle localization headroom exists if oracle_hard beats frozen B41 and matched random on GSK3B Acc@0.65 and real5.
label_rule: atom_edit if node action != KEEP or any incident edge action != KEEP; bond_edit if source-source edge action != KEEP
